data.gender_notes: Ahnaaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahnaaf is derived from the Arabic word 'hanif', which means 'inclined to peace' or 'peacemaker'. It signifies someone who is inclined towards righteousness and peace. The name Ahnaaf carries the meaning “Inclined to peace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahnaaf usually hope their child will grow to embody inclined to peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
